meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. What else do you have?
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Turn the screen toward me. A seventeen-year-old putting a line in the wrong scene is a sloppy citation, Hale, not proof of anything. Is it anywhere else in the play?
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.
I'm writing that down: not in Hamlet, any edition. Whatever happens next, Hale, this stays off Owen's record and it stays quiet, not in front of his class. What else do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that this stay off Owen's record and stay quiet, not in front of his class. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position; she agreed to nothing and still wants this kept off Owen's record and kept quiet, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table before the meeting ended, with her time not yet run out.
What moved her: You showed a quoted line from the essay that does not exist anywhere in Hamlet and let her search the play herself, which worked because it was specific, tied to Owen's own work, and something she could check.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned the early zero in one sentence and went straight to evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed on the essay's text and never came near a late night in October; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she accepted that the line was not in the play and asked what else you had, give her one more checkable piece or offer procedure 4.4 in writing, private and off his record, because that offer would have met her fallback demand.
